subject: Marketplace SKU prioritization & partner onboarding (per-cloud packaging + co-sell handoff)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reynolds (AWS Partner) <aws-partner@aws-partners.com>, GCP Marketplace PM <pm@gcpmarketplace.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace SKU prioritization & partner onboarding (per-cloud packaging + co-sell handoff)

Hi all,

Thanks for taking time to review our proposed listing strategy. This thread is to confirm per-cloud SKU priorities and make sure we have partner onboarding steps nailed for co-sell. High-level asks: confirm the SKU variants below for each cloud, agree on 2 canary regions, and confirm required paperwork/links for partner enablement and co-sell.

Proposed surface (short names for listing):
- Redwood Core (inference API, base throughput) — SKU: RWINF-CORE
- Redwood Pro (dedicated capacity / SLA) — SKU: RWINF-PRO
- Redwood Private (VPC/On-prem) — SKU: RWINF-PRIVATE
- Redwood Optimize (batching/quant) — SKU: RWINF-OPT

Per-cloud notes (initial recommendation):
- AWS: list all SKUs, prioritize RWINF-CORE then RWINF-PRO; canary regions: us-west-2, us-east-1
- Azure: hide RWINF-OPT in initial listing (go to GA quarter later); canaries: eastus, westeurope
- GCP: prioritize RWINF-CORE and RWINF-PRIVATE for regulated customers; canaries: us-central1, europe-west1

Packaging decisions we need from partners:
1) Is marketplace SKU naming acceptable? (AWS has stricter SKU length/char rules)
2) Any cloud-specific packaging or metering we should change?
3) On co-sell: partner enablement link and required legal (DocuSign) for listing + data-processing clauses.

Attachments: proposed_sku_matrix.xlsx (matrix with per-cloud fields), I also attached a compact list of pricing bands in the sheet.

Next steps: if we can get partner onboarding links + legal checklist this week we can sign off on the canary schedule and book the enablement call. Priya — looping you for the customer perspective on packaging (esp. private offering).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Cloud GTM, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 25 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU prioritization & partner onboarding (per-cloud packaging + co-sell handoff)

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick points from the Azure and legal side: 

- Azure SKU names: recommend shortening to RWINF-C, RWINF-P, RWINF-PRIV, RWINF-O to avoid truncation in the marketplace UI. We can map external marketing names to these internal SKUs.
- Canary regions: eastus and westeurope are fine, but request we swap to north europe (northeurope) if we expect heavy EU regulated flows — northwest/eu latency matters for telemetry.
- Legal / compliance: Azure requires a completed Partner Center listing questionnaire and a signed privacy addendum for RWINF-PRIVATE. I can start the Partner Center intake once we have finalized SKU names.

Forwarding Marissa's matrix with inline comments (I added a tab called AZ_changes).

On-canary operational ask: let's ensure telemetry collection is enabled in canary regions so we can measure cold start and KV cache hit rates before a wide rollout.

- Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Adding technical and pricing ops perspective:

- Pricing tiers: recommend three metered bands for RWINF-CORE to align with how infra customers buy compute on marketplaces: Starter (low throughput), Standard, Enterprise. I'll attach a short canary rollout doc that maps user tiers to instance families.
- Metering labels: AWS and GCP both support metered billing via usage reports; we should standardize event names (redwood.tokens_generated, redwood.dedicated_hours) so billing pipelines are consistent.
- Canary rollouts: propose phased canary (week 1 internal only, week 2 limited customer subset, week 3 open) with auto rollback on 2x SLA latency breaches. See attached canary_rollout_plan.md.

Jonas/Marketing: we should define marketplace listing copy per SKU (short description + bullets) so partner portals display consistent messaging.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Sales Ops

Thanks Marissa — team, this looks good. A couple of items from AWS side: 

1) SKU constraints: AWS Marketplace accepts up to 50 characters; your suggested names are fine, but prefer underscore-free SKUs for our internal mapping. We can map marketing display to any label you want.
2) Partner enablement: please complete the listing intake here: https://aws.amazon.com/partner/onboard/XYZ123 — that will kick off legal and entitlements. For co-sell, attach the partner co-sell addendum and provide your AWS Partner Network (APN) ID.
3) DocuSign/legal: we need the signed DPA + co-sell addendum. If you want, I can request the DocuSign packet once Marissa confirms the final SKU list.

Sam Reynolds
